title: MCP tools/call notifications can mutate without returning operation evidence
description: The MCP server treats any JSON-RPC message without id as a notification and dispatches it unless it is initialized/cancelled. A tools/call notification with confirmed=true can execute a mutation but returns no operation ID/result to the client, breaking the audit contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Only known lifecycle notification methods are accepted without id.
tools/call notifications are rejected or ignored before any tool execution.
Regression tests prove confirmed mutating notifications do not change state and normal requests still return operation evidence.
